context:
Use the existing scripts as-is for triage. Migration is mechanical:
  elapsed = time.time() - start  →  elapsed = mono_time() - start
where mono_time() is benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time. Only migrate sites
that compute elapsed durations; preserve sites that record absolute moments.

For the allowlist, group entries by directory with a one-line rationale per
group rather than per-line.
description:
Quality plan Phase 2a. BenchBox has 154 uses of `time.time()` (wall-clock)
and 465 of `mono_time()`/`perf_counter()`. The wall-clock uses are
legitimate for event timestamps but DANGEROUS in benchmark execution paths
(NTP adjustments, leap seconds, system clock changes corrupt measurements).

An allowlist already exists at _project/config/timing_wall_clock_allowlist.json
and a script timing_audit.py / timing_policy_check.py exists, but it is NOT
enforced by CI. Today a contributor can introduce a new wall-clock call in
a hot path and nothing catches it.

This TODO: audit the 154 sites against the allowlist, move any execution-path
uses to mono_time(), then wire timing_policy_check.py into pre-commit + CI.

anti_patterns.dont: add a blanket allowlist entry for whole directories

preserves.behavior: Event timestamps that genuinely need wall-clock (e.g., result file metadata) keep using time.time()
Existing timing_audit.py and timing_policy_check.py interfaces unchanged

verifications.expected: All wall-clock usage either approved in allowlist or migrated

verifications.description: Pre-commit timing hook is wired and passes on the repository
Fast test suite passes after migrations

work_units.summary: Run `_project/scripts/timing_audit.py --report` and triage all 154 time.time() sites - categorize as: (a) event timestamp [keep], (b) execution timing [migrate to mono_time], (c) audit log [keep]
Migrate any category (b) sites to mono_time(); update allowlist for the (a)/(c) cases that aren't yet listed
Add `_project/scripts/timing_policy_check.py --strict` to .pre-commit-config.yaml as a local hook with a stable id (timing-policy-check)
Add a CI step in .github/workflows/lint.yml running `uv run -- python _project/scripts/timing_policy_check.py --strict` - fail on unlisted wall-clock
Document the timing policy in AGENTS.md (1 paragraph) and link from CONTRIBUTING
